title: Shifting a Cubic Curve Left and Down
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The graph of y = x^3 is to be shifted left 1 unit and down 1 unit. Give an equation for the shifted graph and describe the original and shifted curves.

steps.title: Apply the Horizontal Shift (Left 1 Unit)
steps.explanation: Replace x with x + 1 in y = x^3 to shift the cubic curve 1 unit to the left.
steps.why: Replacing x with x + 1 moves the point of inflection from x = 0 to x = -1.

steps.title: Apply the Vertical Shift (Down 1 Unit)
steps.explanation: Subtract 1 from the right-hand side (or replace y with y + 1) to shift the graph 1 unit downward.
steps.why: Subtracting 1 lowers every y-coordinate on the curve by 1 unit.

steps.title: Describe the Original and Shifted Graphs
steps.explanation: The original curve y = x^3 has its inflection point at (0, 0). The shifted curve y = (x + 1)^3 - 1 has its inflection point at (-1, -1) and passes through (0, 0) since (0 + 1)^3 - 1 = 0.
steps.why: Every landmark point (x, y) on y = x^3 translates to (x - 1, y - 1).
